label: AI Extract Information
description: Extracts specific, structured information fields from unstructured text. Each field can be a single value or a list.

config.name: extractionFields
config.description: Array of { name, description, isList } objects describing what to extract.

produces.note: Produces one named output per extractionFields[].name. This is the RELIABLE bridge for splitting a single text blob into multiple named fields for a downstream multi-field consumer (preferred over the Document Parser node, which only ingests documents and does not split fields).
